articles.summary: The inherent ability to combine the power of genetic-like knockdown with the flexibility of small molecules; the power to drug classes of targets that have been elusive to other therapeutic modalities; the use of affinity rather than occupancy-based catalysis - the promise of these advantages has made targeted protein degradation…
articles.title: The First Proof-of-Mechanism in a Randomized, Placebo-controlled Study in Targeted Protein Degradation
